thread:
maria: quick sync on the percentile-rank admission prototype I sketched this morning. want to nail down mapping and failure modes.

jon: read it. curious about the mapping function from rank -> admit. linear 1/score feels brittle.

maria: agreed. proposal: use a logistic mapping so the penalty ramps smoothly. score = tenant_p95 / global_p95; prob = 1 / (1 + exp(beta * (score - 1))) clamped by [min_prob,1]. beta controls steepness.

lee: logistic is nicer. tradeoffs: tuning beta per-region; also small tenants will have high variance.

maria: for small tenants we apply a Bayes shrinkage: compute tenant_mean with prior pulled from cohort (e.g., small accounts bucket). stats use t-digest for percentiles with decay window.

sam: where do we compute t-digests? edge or aggregator? shipping a zillion tiny digests from every proxy could be noisy.

maria: plan: local shard-level t-digests for hot path + central merge for global. proxies cache merged thresholds every 2s (TTL=2s).

jon: 2s TTL is aggressive but good for flash. what about connection loss to aggregator? don't want proxies to keep stale high thresholds.

maria: fallback policy: if aggregator unreachable for >500ms, proxies enter degraded mode: per-tenant token-bucket with conservative refill and emit fallback_count metric. also open circuit if >5 consecutive misses.

lee: reserved/dedicated customers need stronger guarantees. how are they exempted?

maria: reserved bypasses percentile admission entirely; they still go through local SLO checks (queues, max inflight) but never probabilistic shed. burst credits consumed first, admission only after credits exhausted.

jon: how do abuse signals combine? e.g., ML-abuse score should amplify the effective score, not just a binary block.

maria: abuse multiplier m = 1 + w * abuse_score (abuse_score in [0,1]). effective_score = score * m. then feed into logistic. keep w configurable; default w=2 for experiments.

sam: telemetry & debugging: ops needs per-tenant rank and the reason when denied. can't be opaque.

maria: we'll emit audit events for each denial with fields: tenant_id, effective_score, prob, decision_reason, policy_version. short retention (1h) in hot store; full events to long-term for sampled traffic.

ops-bot: deploy: percentile-admit v0.1 canary up in us-west-2

lee: rollout: 1) observe for 7 days; 2) dry-run opt-in 2% traffic mapping-only; 3) 10% probabilistic; 4) region bump and enterprise opt-outs.

jon: testing plan: synthetic loads that vary seq_len and token churn. add chaos where aggregator lags to exercise fallback path.

maria: good. i'll draft a short RFC addendum with config knobs: beta, min_prob, bayes_prior_strength, ttl, fallback_refill_rate, abuse_weight. also include example proxy API.

sam: example please.

maria: snippet below:
```
// Admit RPC (proxy -> admission)
// Request: { tenant: "acct-42", tokens: 128, seq: 1024, region: "us-west-2" }
// Response: { allowed: false, reason: "percentile_shed", prob: 0.18, effective_score: 1.7, fallback: false }
```

jon: nice. small ask: add a debug flag to force admit/deny for a tenant for repro.

maria: will include. tagging @lee @sam for review of the addendum.

lee: looks good. thumbs :thumbsup:
